queries.prompt: Architect an end-to-end AWS Marketplace SaaS control plane with a `x-amzn-marketplace-token` landing page, AWS Step Functions tenant onboarding, and a `MarketplaceTenants` DynamoDB `TenantId` GSI.
Configure EKS Pod Identity and ECS Fargate `TaskRoleArn` least-privilege IAM roles so our AWS Marketplace Paid Container product can call `RegisterUsage` and `MeterUsage`.
Design an EventBridge Scheduler (`rate(1 hour)`) hourly metering aggregator and SQS-buffered SNS onboarding state machine for our multi-tenant Marketplace SaaS.
Why did granting `meteringmarketplace:ResolveCustomer` and `marketplace-entitlement:GetEntitlements` in our SaaS control-plane IAM policy still throw `AccessDeniedException`?
How should our API Gateway authorizer enforce AWS Marketplace SaaS tenant entitlements at `8,000` req/s without hitting `GetEntitlements` throttling on every HTTP call?
Link an AWS Marketplace buyer redirect (`POST /register`) securely to our SaaS OIDC sign-up flow using signed session tokens and cross-account `sts:ExternalId` roles.
Why did our ECS Fargate Marketplace container fail `RegisterUsage` when we attached `aws-marketplace:RegisterUsage` to `ExecutionRoleArn` instead of `TaskRoleArn`?
Write a CloudFormation stack for `MarketplaceTenants` (`CustomerIdentifier` PK + `TenantId` GSI), SQS + DLQ subscription queues, and `aws-marketplace:*` Lambda IAM policies.
Should we embed seller AWS credentials inside our Marketplace container image or rely on buyer-side IAM roles for container metering?
Create a 3-year AWS Marketplace Private Offer (`CreateOffer` + Flexible Payment Scheduler `PaymentScheduleTerm` + CPPO `ResaleAuthorization`) and query `BillingEventFeed_v1` in Athena.
Add a golden AMI version (`AmiSource` + `AccessRoleArn`) to our `AmiProduct` listing via `marketplace-catalog` `StartChangeSet`.
Query `metering-marketplace.amazonaws.com` in CloudTrail Event History and diagnose `TooManyTags`, `MixedAllocatedAndUnallocated`, and `SubmissionExpired` age-out alarms.
